question: Under the cover-page authorization clause, does the separate listing of 'effluent limitations,' 'monitoring requirements,' and 'other conditions' set forth in Parts I–IV establish that enforceable numeric discharge limits for compliance comparison must be sourced only from provisions classified as effluent limitations (excluding monitoring requirements and other conditions), or may any of those three categories supply enforceable numeric discharge limits?
semantic_arguments: The target span incorporates three distinct obligation categories—effluent limitations, monitoring requirements, and other conditions—from Parts I, II, III, and IV
Purpose A requires identifying enforceable numeric discharge limits and distinguishing them from report-only monitoring or monitoring without a numeric compliance comparison
A reading that permits monitoring requirements or other conditions to supply enforceable numeric limits would expand the set of measurement/limit pairs subject to exceedance evaluation
notes: Bounded semantic obligation formulated from the cover-page incorporation clause; truth not determined.
